topic: Review and prioritize dependency updates and security patches.
description: Assess the health of project dependencies, identify outdated or vulnerable packages, and plan updates.
investigationInstructions: List all direct and transitive dependencies with versions.
Identify dependencies with known security vulnerabilities.
Identify outdated dependencies with available updates.
Assess breaking change risk for major version updates.
Group updates by risk level (low, medium, high).
Create an update schedule with testing requirements.
Identify abandoned or unmaintained dependencies to replace.
evidenceRequirements: Test suite coverage for regression validation
expectedOutputStructure: Executive summary with dependency health rating
Update plan grouped by risk level
Breaking change assessment for major versions
Testing and rollback plan for updates
